build_openimages_dataset_builder: build a tensorflow dataset builder for Open Images v4 with configurable image resolution
create_openimages_config: create an OpenImagesV4Config builder config with target pixel resolution for image resizing
run_load_objects: run _load_objects to parse image-level human and machine labels from CSV files
run_load_bboxes: run _load_bboxes to parse bounding box annotations from CSV files
test_resize_image: test _resize_image_if_necessary to downscale images to a target pixel count at JPEG quality 72
